title: Use only registry-declared kebab-case themes on plan-namespace artifacts and contracts

facts.note: The theme registry location named by the source. Creating or editing it activates the rule.

Primary location of plan artifacts (plans, wagons, WMBTs, acceptances, docs). Artifacts or contracts outside plan/ are in scope only if file_kind below classifies them as using the plan theme namespace.

theme_bearing_artifact / theme_bearing_contract = an artifact or contract whose theme field or identity first segment refers to the repository-owned plan theme namespace governed by plan/_themes.yaml (i.e. a plan artifact, or a contract whose identity is namespaced by a plan theme). Mere presence of a 'theme' key is NOT sufficient: UI/visual themes, editor/tooling themes and any other theme system are excluded even when they declare theme values. theme_registry = plan/_themes.yaml. Requires an extractor that recognises the plan artifact/contract schema, not just a field name or extension.
Task text mentions plan themes, the registry or theme-prefixed identities; must be read in the plan-namespace sense.
Static checker over plan-namespace artifacts/contracts plus plan/_themes.yaml.

fires: A plan artifact (plan, wagon, WMBT, acceptance, doc) is created or edited and declares or changes its theme or theme-prefixed identity.
A contract whose identity is namespaced by a plan theme is created or edited, in any directory.
plan/_themes.yaml is created, or an entry is added, renamed, reordered or removed.
Planner reviews a plan artifact or contract that assigns or references a plan theme.
doesNotFire: Files that do not use the plan theme namespace and are not plan/_themes.yaml.
UI/visual, editor, documentation-site or any other non-plan theme configuration, even when it declares a theme key or value.
Prose that mentions the word theme in an unrelated sense.

given: A plan artifact or contract uses the repository plan theme namespace (theme field or theme-prefixed identity), or plan/_themes.yaml is involved.
when: You author, edit or review such an artifact, contract or the theme registry.
then: Every declared theme must be a value in the repository registry plan/_themes.yaml (registry membership).
prefer: Add the theme to plan/_themes.yaml before any artifact or contract references it.
Required: theme names are kebab-case matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.
Required: registry index 0 is commons, the only reserved entry; the repository declares every other theme.
Required: the first segment of every artifact or contract identity equals its declared theme.
avoid: Declaring a theme absent from plan/_themes.yaml.
Theme names with uppercase, underscores, spaces or leading digits/hyphens.
Removing, renaming or moving commons off index 0, or reserving another entry.
An identity whose first segment differs from its theme.
why: A theme is a repository-defined namespace for plan artifacts; registry membership and identity-prefix consistency are what make it enforceable.
evidence: Every plan-namespace theme value on an artifact or contract appears in plan/_themes.yaml.
Every registry entry and declared theme matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.
plan/_themes.yaml entry at index 0 is exactly commons.
For each plan-namespace artifact or contract, the first segment of its identity equals its declared theme.
verifier_detail: Reserved index 0 value: commons (the only reserved entry; all others are repository-declared).
Membership check: every declared theme is a value in the repository registry.
Identity-prefix check: the first segment of an artifact or contract identity equals its theme.
Term model: theme -> {kebab-case namespace, registry membership, identity prefix}. Membership and identity-prefix consistency are the enforceable parts of this definition.

Scope: classify by use of the plan theme namespace (plan artifact schema, or contract identity namespaced by a plan theme), never by a bare 'theme' key; exclude UI and other theme systems. Default check scope is the artifacts/contracts/registry touched by the change; because the invariants are unconditional, a verifier MAY optionally scan full repository state, but this is a verification strategy, not an authoring duty.

splitSuggestion.then: Entry index 0 of plan/_themes.yaml is commons.
The first segment of an artifact or contract identity equals its theme.

sharedNodes.text: Advisory semantic anchor: a definitional node that gives the artifact a stable meaning but is not itself bound to a validator; it is transitively protected by the enforceable constraint/rule nodes that require it.

additions.text: Source bundles four checks (registry membership, kebab-case format, commons at index 0, identity prefix). Membership kept in then; the other three are marked 'Required:' in prefer (mandatory) and mirrored in avoid/evidence, and proposed as separate conventions (theme-zero-mandatory and urn-namespace-matches already exist in the graph).
additions.justification: One obligation per then, without weakening the mandatory invariants.

additions.text: Add the theme to plan/_themes.yaml before any artifact or contract references it.
additions.justification: Restates the membership rule as an ordering; adds no new obligation.

Contracts outside plan/ are included only when their identity is namespaced by a plan theme, reflecting the source's 'artifact or contract identity' wording.
additions.justification: Required by schema for observable activation; scoped to the source's 'namespace for plan artifacts'.
